detail: adjudicator returned not_ready — New workflow compares timestamp > deadline instead of >= deadline, systematically missing settlements that arrive exactly at the deadline. With a 12-second tolerance window (one block), there is no margin to recover; every miss is a degraded epoch that cannot be retried.; Cached deadline is not properly refreshed after epoch settlement, causing subsequent blocks to trigger on stale deadlines. This cascades from each missed settlement into further incorrect state.; Root cause must be identified and corrected: either the comparison operator or the cache invalidation logic (or both). The current implementation will record every epoch settlement as missed until fixed.
